title: 已完结热门小说推荐
content:
“该死！！”哈德逊河全长507千米，发源于阿迪朗达克山脉，一路自北向南，流经包括纽约、波基浦西、金斯顿、奥尔巴尼在内等十几个东部沿岸城市。而这样一座分支众多的大型河流意味着，当一个力大无穷又刀枪不入的超人类跳进里面，不管怎么想都很难把他找出来了。这让得知消息，第一时间从纽约警局总部赶过来的雷.凯利懊悔不已。一个能更进一步，甚至好几步的好机会摆在他面前，他却没有珍惜。更糟糕的是，因为这次行动出现中的重大伤亡，他这个警察局长说不定还要担责。“FUCK！！”越想越气，雷.凯利叫来那个关键时刻出现纰漏的狙击手一顿痛骂。“呃，局长，最后射中那个怪物右眼的一枪也是我开的啊......”这名狙击手还有点委屈，觉得自己罪不至死，起码也有那么一丁点功劳吧。“闭嘴，要不是你这个蠢货突然脑子进了屎开枪，我们现在都已经招揽卢克.邓肯成功了。”看到这家伙还敢顶嘴，雷.凯利气得都爆了粗口。而一旁比他更早一步来到现场的乔治.詹特利，正遵循以往的习惯穿戴着手套、鞋套，半蹲在地，冷静搜寻着现场遗留下来的一些他想要的线索。即使刚刚激战过的桥面上血腥无比，最专业的尸检官来了也得吐，他那张古板严峻的脸上也没有什么多余的表情，在周围同事甚至有些惊悚的目光下，戴着手套，在那些尸堆里面仔细翻动。“呕，呕......”看着这堪称变态的一幕，几位平时也算老练的警探实在忍不住了，捂住嘴到一旁干呕。正在气头上的雷.凯利也被这一出整得情绪有点不连贯了。他有些无奈地看了一眼在尸堆里认真翻动，比变态杀人狂看着还像变态杀人狂的心腹爱将，语气放缓道：“乔治，这些活交给鉴定科和法医科的人就行了，你马上就要升官了，在公众面前要注意自己的形象。”“马上就好。”乔治.詹特利我行我素继续干着自己的事。直到在旁边，发现一枚弹头凹陷，特殊标记过的的12.7mm狙击枪子弹后，他严肃的脸上才露出一丝笑意，抬起头道：“局长，或许我们这次也不是一点收获都没有。”......“真是一场酣畅淋漓的战斗啊。”

与此同时，远在酒店总统套房的陆白感慨出声，脸上同样是掩饰不住的笑意。虽然在战斗发生之后，纽约警局已经有意识疏散附近的人群了。但纽约布鲁克林大桥毕竟是纽约一个著名的旅游景点，被誉为继世界古代七大奇迹之后的第八大奇迹，周围的游客还是很多的。可能他们没有近距离围观的勇气，但偷偷拍个视频、然后发到网上的胆子还是大大滴有的。比如说一名来自得克萨斯州的游客就把自己拍摄的视频，发布到了油管上。短短时间内就获得了一千万多的浏览量，和三百多万的点赞。如果不是这个视频很快就被屏蔽下架，这个德州小伙子很有可能一夜成名，变成一名大网红。但即使如此，如同好莱坞大片里一样的画面，变异人类和警察的激烈交锋，还是让这次发生在布鲁克林大桥的战斗赚足了眼球，也让陆白一次性收获了超过一万的愿力。原本看起来颇为古旧的白泽精怪图，都因此变得鲜活了一些，并且多出了一个新功能，储物。只要是陆白能拿得动的东西，通通都可以放进白泽精怪图中。这里面的空间大到没边。像是他之前看到崇吾山很多特产却没法拿回来的遗憾，此刻统统都可以弥补。“真不错。”把总统套房里的家具放进放出，实验了一番白泽精怪图这个新功能的陆白满意点点头，觉得这才是一个金手指该有的样子。要不然名头叫的这么响，连个储物功能都没有，那也太寒酸了。“那么，接下来就剩下最后一项了......”隐隐感觉到愿力充足之后，他从举父还有比翼鸟那里拓印来的天赋能力还可以升级的陆白闭上眼，面色严肃道：“深蓝，加点。”轰！！一瞬之间，陆白辛辛苦苦赚来的一万一千多点愿力只剩下个零头，大量灰白色气流涌入白泽精怪图中最初被点亮的举父和比翼鸟画像。肉眼可见的，这两名异兽画像颜色看起来都比之前深了一些，带着某种独特的神韵。与两名异兽同源的强大力量源源不断反馈到陆白身上。他的身形漂浮在半空，衣服被再次增长一截的体型撑破，露出肌肉线条分明、宛若希腊雕塑的上半身。“这种不断变强的感觉可真是......嗨到不行啊。”半饷后，完全适应了这份力量的陆白睁开眼，抬手一招，房间内所有家具物品全部漂浮了起来。
content_en:
"Damn!!" The Hudson River is 507 kilometers long. It originates from the Adirondack Mountains and flows from north to south through more than a dozen eastern coastal cities including New York, Poughkeepsie, Kingston, and Albany.And such a large river with many branches means that when a superhuman with infinite strength and invulnerability jumps into it, it will be difficult to find him no matter how hard you think.This made Ray Kelly, who rushed over from the New York Police Department headquarters as soon as he heard the news, regretful.A good opportunity to take one step further, or even several steps, was placed in front of him, but he did not cherish it.What's worse is that because of the heavy casualties in this operation, he, the police chief, may be held responsible."FUCK!!" The more he thought about it, the angrier he became. Ray Kelly called over the sniper who made the mistake at the critical moment and scolded him."Uh, Director, I was the one who fired the last shot that hit the monster's right eye..." The sniper was still a little aggrieved. He felt that his crime was not worthy of death, so at least he had some merit."Shut up, if you idiot didn't suddenly get into your head and shoot, we would have successfully recruited Luke Duncan by now." Seeing that this guy still dared to talk back, Ray Kelly was so angry that he cursed.On the side, George Gentry, who arrived at the scene earlier than him, was wearing gloves and shoe covers according to his past habits, squatting on the ground, calmly searching for some clues he wanted left at the scene.Even though the bridge where they had just fought was extremely bloody, even the most professional coroner was still vomiting when he came. There was no unnecessary expression on his old-fashioned and stern face. Under the even horrified gazes of his colleagues around him, he wore gloves and carefully turned over the pile of corpses."Ugh, vomit..." Seeing this perverted scene, several usually experienced police detectives couldn't bear it anymore and covered their mouths and retched aside.Ray Kelly, who was in a state of anger, was also emotionally disturbed by this incident.He glanced helplessly at his confidant who was carefully rummaging through the pile of corpses and looked more like a perverted murderer than a perverted murderer. He said in a slow tone: "George, just leave these tasks to the people in the identification department and the forensic department. You will be promoted soon. You must pay attention to your image in front of the public." "Very soon." George Gentry continued to do his own thing.It wasn't until he found a 12.7mm sniper rifle bullet with a dented warhead and a special mark beside him that a smile appeared on his serious face. He raised his head and said, "Director, maybe we didn't gain nothing this time."... "It was really a hearty battle."

At the same time, Lu Bai, who was far away in the presidential suite of the hotel, sighed with emotion, with the same smile that couldn't be concealed on his face.Although after the fighting, the New York Police Department had consciously evacuated nearby crowds.But after all, the Brooklyn Bridge in New York is a famous tourist attraction in New York. It is known as the eighth wonder after the seven ancient wonders of the world, and there are still many tourists around it.Maybe they don't have the courage to watch at close range, but they still have the courage to secretly take a video and post it online.For example, a tourist from Texas posted a video he shot on YouTube.In a short period of time, it received more than 10 million views and more than 3 million likes.If this video hadn't been quickly blocked and taken down, this Texas guy would have become famous overnight and become a big internet celebrity.But even so, the fierce confrontation between mutated humans and the police, just like the scene in a Hollywood blockbuster, still made the battle on the Brooklyn Bridge draw enough attention, and also allowed Lu Bai to gain more than 10,000 willpower at one time.The pictures of Bai Ze's monsters that originally looked quite old have become a little more lively, and have a new function, storage.As long as Lu Bai can hold anything, everything can be put into the Bai Ze spirit picture.The space here is endless.For example, the regret he had before when he saw many specialties from Chongwu Mountain but could not get them back can be made up for now."It's really good." Lu Bai put the furniture in the presidential suite in and out, and experimented with the new function of Bai Ze's ghost picture. He nodded with satisfaction, thinking that this is what a golden finger should look like.Otherwise, with such a loud name and no storage function, it would be too shabby."Then, there is only one last item left..." Lu Bai, who vaguely felt that his willpower was sufficient and that the talents he had copied from his father and Biyiniao could still be upgraded, closed his eyes and said with a serious face: "Dark Blue, add more." Boom!!In an instant, Lu Bai's hard-earned more than 11,000 points of will power were only a fraction, and a large amount of gray-white air flow poured into the first illuminated portraits of Jufu and Biyiniao in Bai Ze's ghost picture.Visible to the naked eye, the portraits of these two alien beasts appear darker than before, with a certain unique charm.The powerful power from the same source as the two alien beasts continuously fed back to Lu Bai.His figure was floating in the air, and his clothes were torn apart by his growing body, revealing his upper body with clear muscle lines, like a Greek sculpture."This feeling of constantly getting stronger is really... so exciting." After half a meal, Lu Bai, who had fully adapted to this power, opened his eyes, raised his hand, and all the furniture and items in the room floated.
